target.statement: FID score of CoSeR on ImageNet Test2000 (4x SR) is 19.41, compared to StableSR's 22.53
target.dataset: ImageNet Test2000 (2000 LR-HR pairs, 128x128 LR, 512x512 HR)

compute.basis: Inference on 2000 images with a 200-step diffusion model and ControlNet requires GPU; on CPU it would take many hours, and the model weights are large.

blockers: Requires GPU for reasonable runtime (200-step diffusion per image)
Model weights (Stable Diffusion 2.1-base + CoSeR checkpoints) are large and may not be fully released
Test set construction requires Real-ESRGAN degradation pipeline and ImageNet data
title: CoSeR: Bridging Image and Language for Cognitive Super-Resolution
